hook: You say money cannot solve all your problems. Good. But neither can mathematics.
full_script: You say money cannot solve all your problems. Good. But neither can mathematics. Last week, my mathematician friend called me to borrow twenty thousand naira to buy baby formula. If a senior mathematician cannot feed a toddler with calculus, why are you doing simple addition? Hard work pays, but it pays minimum wage. That is why billionaires do not work to chase currency; they work to construct perceived value. Anybody who is more successful than you simply possesses vital information that you have not humbled yourself to seek. Without information, you are running in circles. Stop trying to calculate your way out of poverty. Upgrade your economic output, or your baby will be drinking pure water instead of formula.
